meta.ogDescription: The musician's app: your progress measured in tempo, your repertoire, your covers and your band. Early access is open.

play.title: A practice log
play.description: Metronome, tuner, exercises and session timer. The tempo you hold is measured session after session, not guessed.

library.title: Your songs on shelves
library.description: What you're working on, what you want to learn, what you've mastered. Tab, tuning and target tempo in one place.

community.title: Your covers, your friends
community.description: Post your covers, rate the albums you listen to, challenge your musician friends to practice.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.detail: Tap tempo, 7 time signatures, subdivisions, accents, muted bars

tuner.name: Tuner
tuner.detail: Real-time note detection through the mic

sessions.name: Sessions
sessions.detail: Timer, BPM reached, sections worked, mood of the day

progress.name: Progress
progress.detail: Practice calendar, streaks, tempo curve per song

exercises.name: Exercises
exercises.detail: Tailored to your instrument, from starting tempo to target tempo

routines.name: Routines
routines.detail: Your go-to session, songs and exercises, restarted in one tap

setlists.name: Setlists
setlists.detail: Drag and drop, played sections, PDF export for the stage

bands.name: Bands

recognition.name: Recognition
recognition.detail: Play a song to the app, find it and add it

challenges.name: Challenges
challenges.detail: Practice time, streaks, a song to master with friends

offer.a: The first {spots} people to sign up get {months} months free on the plan they picked when their access opens: Band for Band, Pro for Pro, and Pro too for those who picked Free. No credit card, no commitment: at the end, you keep your plan or go back to Free.

when.a: We're opening access in waves, in sign-up order. You'll get an email with your access link when it's your turn.

pay.a: No. The plan you pick just tells us what you're interested in. You can start for free and change plans whenever you like.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes, on iPhone and Android, and on desktop. Ostinara installs from your browser to your home screen, like an app, without going through a store.

beginner.q: I'm a beginner, is it for me?
beginner.a: Yes. Ostinara is built for beginner to intermediate musicians, on guitar, bass, drums or keys: knowing what you're working on and seeing yourself improve is what keeps you going.

band.a: The Band plan adds band spaces: rehearsals with RSVPs and reminders, chat, shared setlists and synced jam sessions.

footer.tagline: The all-in-one app for musicians who want to improve and share.
